control_packages.qualification: No inferred CAD or source tolerance
Same normal-incidence comparison scope; source/gain/frame changes require requalification
No source-reported calibration schedule or cell-by-cell calibration experiment
One broadband scan can generate correlated frequency views
5/20/35/45/25 degrees belong to different source branches, not a complete historical schedule
Measured spectrum interpretation must retain resolution and ambient sound-speed uncertainty
Fitting loss to a measured case does not independently validate that same case
Keep failed attempts and unnormalized amplitudes; no outcome-based exclusion

repetition_policy.rule: Work order defines allocation and stopping criteria before acquisition. Cell type, layer, pixel, frequency and angle are conditions or locations, not independent specimen replicates. All retries retain original failures.
